GIF.subject: Agricultural Extension & Marketing
GIF.question: Of that upper block, the first two codes are already taken: _____n for CLEAR and 2n + 1 for STOP
GIF.fact: If the symbol width is n, the codes of width n+1 fall naturally into two blocks: the lower block of 2n codes for coding single symbols, and the upper block of 2n codes that will be used by the decoder for sequences of length greater than one. Of that upper block, the first two codes are already taken: 2n for CLEAR and 2n + 1 for STOP.
